source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Recognize their current symptom status and know when to take specific self-care actions or contact their provider, based on color-coded thresholds","B":"Taking the place of the ongoing provider follow-up visits the client would otherwise still need to attend on a regular schedule","C":"Carrying fairly little established educational value for a client trying to manage their heart failure symptoms independently at home","D":"Tracking the client's blood glucose levels throughout the day rather than their heart failure-related symptoms and warning signs"}}
source_row.rationale: A heart failure zone tool (commonly color-coded as green for stable, yellow for caution, and red for emergency) helps the client recognize their current symptom status and know when to take specific self-care actions or contact their provider, based on clear, easy-to-understand thresholds.
